span.label: Creativity was operationalised only as novelty, because influence could not be measured.
span.note: what this limits: what the word creative means in this work: SINCE INFLUENCE IS NOT RELEVANT HERE, WE USE NOVELTY AS A PROXY FOR CREATIVITY

span.label: The system has no semantic understanding of art beyond style categories.

span.label: The authors cannot explain why subjects rated CAN images above the human Art Basel set.
span.note: what this limits: the headline comparison, which the authors decline to interpret: WE LEAVE OPEN HOW TO INTERPRET THE HUMAN SUBJECTS' RESPONSES THAT RANKED THE CAN ART BETTER THAN THE ART BASEL SAMPLES
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Further experiments are needed to settle the interpretation of the results.
span.note: what this limits: the same scope as item 4: MORE EXPERIMENTS ARE DEFINITELY NEEDED TO HELP ANSWER THESE QUESTIONS
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Creativity is implemented as making a classifier maximally unsure which style it is looking at.
span.note: what this limits: the creativity claimed for these images: it is implemented as maximising the entropy of the style class posterior, that is, as being hard for the style classifier to assign to any class
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The style vocabulary is a fixed list whose length is a design parameter of the network.
span.note: what this limits: the style categories used here: they are a fixed set whose size K is a network design parameter, fixed by the label set of the training corpus rather than by art history
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The paper's own object is scare-quoted in its title.
span.note: what this limits: the claim that this system generates art: the paper's title puts the word in quotation marks and describes the method as learning about styles and deviating from style norms

span.label: style - AS A CLASS IN A CLASSIFIER: the network's final layer has K outputs where K is the number of style classes, so here the word names a position in a label set rather than any property of the picture, and an image's style is whichever index wins
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: style ambiguity - AS POSTERIOR ENTROPY: the generator is rewarded for making the style classifier uncertain, so 'deviating from style norms' is implemented as producing images the classifier cannot place, and creativity becomes a property of a confusion matrix
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: novelty - INHERITED FROM BERLYNE'S COLLATIVE VARIABLES: it is one of five arousal-raising properties named in an aesthetics theory - novelty, surprisingness, complexity, ambiguity and puzzlingness - and this system implements the fourth of them while the record's limitation says creativity was operationalised as the first
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.
